Name: FF2.0_LBXLW's RedFox and RainFrog Outdoor Large Furniture Catalogue
Author: labixiaoluwan
Description:
[size=4]Outdoor furnitures designed to match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34044][RedFox and RainFrog Furniture][/url] and [/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34168][RedFox and RainFrog Farmhouse][/url] .
